jobs.description: About us:  Welcome to Crowne Plaza Amsterdam – South, a modern business hotel in the lively Zuidas district.  With 207 rooms, 7 meeting venues, and buzzing spots like De Japanner Zuid and the Manhattan Lounge-Bar, we offer guests and team members a place to connect, grow, and belong — as part of the global IHG Hotels & Resorts family.  Your day to day:  • Assist the Breakfast Chef in daily breakfast service, including preparation and execution of the à la carte menu  • Support with banqueting when required with food preparation and operational tasks • Prepare ingredients and mise en place for breakfast and other outlets as directed • Manage and operate the live omelette station, ensuring quality and guest interaction • Maintain cleanliness and organization of your workstation and storage areas in compliance with HACCP standards • Follow food safety, hygiene, and company procedures at all times • During quieter periods, assist with additional tasks such as staff meals or preparation for other outlets • Work collaboratively with the kitchen team to ensure smooth and efficient service Functie-eisen:Job Requirements:  • Available to start shifts at 06:00 AM • Flexible and adaptable to operational needs • Eager to learn and develop culinary skills • Previous kitchen experience is preferred but not required • Available to work weekends, bank holidays, and holiday periods • Fluent in spoken and written English • Confident interacting with guests in a polite and professional manner • Team-oriented with a positive attitude and strong work ethic  At Crowne Plaza Amsterdam – South, we make sure you feel right at home with:  • Employee discount for all 6000+ IHG hotels worldwide  • Friends & family rates to share with your loved ones  • Travel allowance based on the distance from home to work  • A paid day off for volunteering  • A paid day off for your birthday or a birthday voucher  • Homemade lunch or dinner during your working h
